name: LTX 2.5 IC-LoRA — video to video (canny edges + audio)
description:
Restyle a video while keeping its outlines and motion. Upload a source video (and, optionally, a start image): the edges of every frame are traced (Canny edge detection) and used as a guide, so LTX 2.5 generates a new video whose shapes, silhouettes and details line up with the original — in the style of your prompt and start image — with a freshly generated soundtrack (the original audio is not kept).

Edges hold on to more of the source's exact shapes and fine lines than the depth version, so this one suits restyles that must stay recognisable (faces, lettering, architecture); the depth version leaves the model more freedom over surfaces and textures. Busy, noisy footage produces busy edges — clean, well-lit shots work best. Strong, physical looks (claymation, toy figures) take hold best; soft painterly styles such as watercolor can stay close to the photographic source.

The start image becomes the opening frame; a restyled still of your video's first frame works best. Untick "Use a start image" to let the prompt alone set the look — then no image is needed. "Enhance prompt with AI" lets a small Gemma model rewrite your prompt into a fuller description first. Lower "Control strength" to let the result drift further from the source's outlines.

Only the start of your clip is used ("Clip length used", default 5 s), at its own frame rate and aspect ratio. The video is rendered in two passes, a fast 8-step pass at the working resolution and then a 2× upscale pass, so a working resolution of 512 gives a 1024p result. Clip length and resolution drive the time.

promptGuides.label: LTX union control (depth / canny / pose) — Lightricks
promptGuides.tip: Describe the look you want — style, materials, characters, lighting, sound — not the motion or the control map: the movement comes from your video.

author: Lightricks (ComfyUI-LTXVideo)

exposedParameters.label: Prompt (scene / style / action / sound)
exposedParameters.default: A hand-crafted claymation stop-motion film: soft rounded clay characters and props with visible fingerprints, warm pastel colors, soft studio lighting and a shallow depth of field. The motion follows the original shot naturally. Gentle ambient sounds match the scene.

exposedParameters.label: Control strength (how strictly the source's outlines are followed)
Working resolution (short side, multiple of 64 — the final video is 2× this)
Clip length used (seconds, max 10 — only the start of your video is processed)

warmupParams.primitivestringmultiline_value_5508: a claymation version of the scene, soft studio light
